---
title: "Practice exercises: titles, themes, and annotations"
---

The exercises below run in your browser and check your code automatically, giving you feedback as you go. Like the other ggplot2 exercises, these are checked by comparing your **code** to a model solution, so the feedback will point you to a specific part of your code to fix. The last two are a bit more of a challenge - don't worry if you need a few tries.
